Bridging Canada and Japan

Health care in Japan, coordinated from Vancouver

Pacific Medical Concierge helps people in Canada explore health screenings and medical services in Japan. We are a non-medical coordinator: we guide you through the process, and qualified medical professionals in Japan make the clinical decisions and provide your care.

Get in touch

Why Pacific Medical Concierge

1A Vancouver-based point of contact.

You deal with someone here in Canada, who bridges the distance, language and systems between you and Japan.

2Japan-side experience.

Our Japan-side contact has experience coordinating medical tourism, and works with us to identify appropriate options.

3Process and communication first.

Our focus is the practical process — clear steps, clear responsibilities, and communication you can follow — not just travel bookings.

4Costs explained before you decide.

Costs vary substantially by institution and service, so we do not publish prices. You will receive the relevant pricing information and have the opportunity to review it before deciding whether to proceed.

Services

Health Screenings (Ningen Dock)

Premium Japanese health screenings — ningen dock — are our main service. We are committed to arranging them at highly credible medical institutions in Japan.

Stem Cell Services

We coordinate inquiries about stem cell injections in Japan, and can refer you to a renowned doctor in Tokyo, where treatment is paired with a luxurious stay. The provider — not Pacific Medical Concierge — assesses suitability, explains the risks and provides any treatment. We make no claims about results or effectiveness.

Documents and Language Support

As part of coordinating your case, we help with translation of medical documents between English and Japanese, and clear English-language summaries of your results — drawing on professional experience in medical translation and proofreading.

Advanced Treatments

Treatments such as PET scans, Gamma Knife and ZAP-X radiosurgery are available in Japan today. What we coordinate is access: each case is reviewed by the provider, who confirms whether the treatment can be offered.

How It Works

  1. 1

    Contact us

    Email us with a general inquiry. Please include only your basic contact details and the service you are interested in — not medical records.

  2. 2

    Discuss your needs

    We will explain how the coordination process works and learn what you are interested in.

  3. 3

    Explore options in Japan

    We work with our Japan-side contact to identify appropriate options, subject to availability.

  4. 4

    Provider review

    The medical institution determines what information it needs and whether it can offer the requested service.

  5. 5

    Review arrangements and costs

    You receive the available information about the institution, the service and the costs, before deciding whether to proceed.

  6. 6

    Prepare for the visit

    The agreed communication and travel arrangements are coordinated.

  7. 7

    Visit and follow-up

    The medical provider explains your findings and any medical next steps. For follow-up once you're home, we can introduce you to a doctor from our network across Canada.

Specific arrangements — including interpretation, document handling and follow-up — are confirmed for each client and provider.

About

Pacific Medical Concierge was founded by a small group of individuals who share a passion for helping people in Canada receive state-of-the-art medical screenings and care in Japan.

Through our Japan-side partner — who has coordinated medical travel for international patients and built long-standing relationships with hospitals and specialists across Japan, including connections formed through work with advanced treatment technologies such as Gamma Knife radiosurgery — we connect you to that network and coordinate each step, from exploring options to provider review, arrangements and follow-up.

We are coordinators, not medical providers. All clinical decisions are made by the qualified medical professionals who provide your care in Japan.

Privacy Policy

Pacific Medical Concierge respects your privacy. This policy explains how we handle personal information when you contact us or use our services.

Information we may collect

When you contact us, we may collect your name, contact information and details about the services you are interested in. If you choose to proceed, we may need additional information to coordinate with a medical institution. Please do not send medical records in your initial email. We will explain what information is needed and how to share it.

How we use information

We may use your information to respond to inquiries, communicate with you, and coordinate requested services and arrangements.

Sharing information

With your consent, we may share relevant information with medical institutions, our Japan-side coordination contact, interpreters or travel professionals when needed for the arrangements you request. Some recipients may be located outside Canada, including in Japan.

Your choices and questions

To ask about your personal information, request access or correction, or discuss withdrawing consent, contact: Pacific Medical Concierge — care@pacmedconcierge.com
